subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT about Tata Institute of Fundamental Research?

options.text: Aided by the Department of Atomic Energy
A national centre of the Government of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**a private-sector institute**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• TIFR is **not a private-sector institute**; it is a public research institution.
 
• It is **aided by the Department of Atomic Energy** (DAE) and is a **national centre** of the Government of India.
 
• It has the status of a **deemed university** and is renowned for research in science and mathematics.
 
• It was originally founded with the support of the Tata Trust in 1945, but its operations are now primarily sustained by the Indian government, particularly through the DAE.
 
• TIFR's headquarters is in Mumbai, and it has additional research centres across India.
 
• It plays a key role in India's scientific research, contributing to major projects, including the development of India's nuclear program, space research, and various international scientific collaborations.
